market_question: Will the Democratic Party win the CA-15 House seat?
reasoning: CA-15 is an extremely safe Democratic seat (Cook PVI D+28) in the SF Bay Area. The district gave the Democrat 78% in 2022, and no Republican has come close under current lines. Barring an extraordinary event, the Democrat is virtually certain to win, making the 94.5% market probability too low.
evidence_points: Cook Partisan Voter Index rates CA-15 at D+28, among the bluest districts in the nation.
In 2022, the Democratic candidate won 78% to 22%, a 56-point margin.
The district has a heavy Democratic registration advantage and is unlikely to change significantly before 2026.
